title: BookingCompletedFrame
description: Frame `booking_completed` goway-realtime sends to an app.

data.title: BookingCompletedData
data.description: The haul is closed; the app reads the booking for the bill and asks for a rating. The internal event's ids for organizations, recipients and the event itself never reach an app.

load_code.description: The load's short code, for example `GW-7F3K2M`; wallets and receipts show it.

completed_at.description: When the haul was closed; the code allows null, it is always set. ISO 8601 with offset, as Python's `isoformat()` writes it.

completed_by.title: CompletedBy
completed_by.description: Who closed the haul: `carrier` when the driver finishes it at the drop-off, `system` for the auto-complete sweep.

ts.description: When the server sent the frame, RFC 3339 UTC.
